name: Generic Fallback
description: Fallback template when no specific WorkType template matches. All promises default to manual review.

clarifying_questions.question: What specific changes are you requesting?
Which files and modules are in scope?

example_contract:
CONTRACT: CTR-GENERIC01
  TYPE: FEATURE
  SCOPE: [user-specified]
  MODULES: [user-specified]
  RISK CAP: MEDIUM
  PROMISES:
    1. Implement changes → verify: manual_review
    2. Scope respected → verify: manual_review
  STATUS: proposed
